resources.string: Markets, charts and news — no sign-up. Signals and copy trading with a free account.
Signals and copy trading, with a free account
CoinePro sells no subscription and has no in-app purchase. We are paid a commission by the exchange on your trading — not by you.
Register at LBank or Ourbit through CoinePro\'s referral link.
Fund the account to at least 50 USDT.
Enter your exchange UID in the app.
Verification runs automatically against the exchange API, and access opens.
Automatic copy trading is on LBank. Ourbit does not offer it; an Ourbit user receives the signals and places the trades themselves.
Step one matters: an account opened without the referral link is not a CoinePro sub-account in the exchange\'s own system, and cannot be verified afterwards.
